name: Elven Welcome-Token
description: A small woven cord, bead, or carved disc given by an elven host to a sanctioned visitor — a relational artifact whose legitimacy comes from its provenance, not its form.
narrative_effects: The Feywood's ambient field registers the bearer as a welcome guest. Path-finding is subtly more cooperative; the Feywood's geometry favors the bearer's intended destinations.
Legitimacy derives from the specific act of giving by a recognized host — a stolen or forged token confers nothing, and attempts to forge one are recognizable to attuned elven observers.
Typically carried on the person (worn at the wrist, neck, or on a belt) for the duration of a visit; returned or kept as a memento when the visit concludes.

mechanical_effect.trigger: carried on the person by the legitimate recipient during the sanctioned visit for which it was given
mechanical_effect.applies_to: Feywood path-finding, ambient-field cooperation, and checks where being registered as a welcome guest helps movement toward intended destinations
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: stolen or forged tokens; uses outside the host-sanctioned visit; social authority beyond welcome-guest status; regions outside the Feywood ambient field
